source: Chapter 703: Fused Ability
target: Capitulum 703: Facultas Coniuncta

source: Translator: CKtalon
target: Interpretator: CKtalon

source: Black… When it comes to luck, this color signifies they’ll face a deadly calamity…
target: Niger… Quod ad fortunam attinet, hic color significat eos calamitate letali subiturum esse…

source: If the hue isn’t dense, could it mean the calamity is potentially fatal but avoidable—that there’s a chance of overcoming it?
target: Si color non est densus, an hoc significet calamitatem esse, potentialiter mortiferam sed vitabilem, et occasionem superandi praebere?

source: Yes, I watch others going forward.
target: Ita, ego alios procedentes observo.

source: I might spot dense black.
target: Fortasse ego densum nigrum percipere possum.

source: Maybe that implies if the corresponding tributary is selected, a deadly fate is sealed…
target: Forsitan hoc indicat, si tributaria electa fuerit, fatum letale signatum esse…

source: Lumian continued observing Franca and Hela’s fates, forming a related hypothesis.
target: Lumian fata Francae et Helae perseveranter observabat, hypothesim ad rem cognatam formans.

source: Since the tributaries constantly shifted, Lumian couldn’t fully grasp a target’s future fate.
target: Cum tributaria constanter mutarentur, Lumian fatum futuri obiecti non plene capere potuit.

source: He could only catch glimpses of a few possibilities.
target: Ipse solummodo paucae possibilitates adspicere potuit.

source: The black “mark” let him pinpoint the critical junctures.
target: Notam nigrum ei permisit momenta critica perspicere.

source: This wasn’t covered in the mystical knowledge accompanying a Fate Appropriator’s power.
target: Hoc non comprehensum erat in scientia mystica quae cum potentia Fati Appropriatoris coniuncta erat.

source: Lumian strongly suspected that once Luck Observation evolved into Fate Observation, it could merge with a Reaper’s Weakness Investigation to create this unique ability.
target: Lumian vehementer suspicabatur, cum Observatio Fortunae in Observatiōnem Fati evaserit, eam coniungi posse cum Investigatione Debilitatum Messoris ad hanc unicam facultatem creandam.

source: It was like exposing a target’s physical and spiritual weak points—the tributary leading to their demise!
target: Erant quasi revelatio vulnerabilium physicarum atque spiritualium obiecti—tributarium quod ad eorum exitium ducit!

source: As I suspected, the Hunter and Inevitability pathways’ visual abilities have combined…
target: Ut suspicabar, artes visivae viae Venatoris et Inevitabilitatis coniunctae sunt…

source: Lumian used the chance to examine Hela and Franca’s fate rivers, realizing he could perceive fragments of their past and present destinies, similar to when he used Fallen Mercury to discern others’ fates.
target: Lumian occasione usus est ad exquirenda flumina fatum Helae et Francae, animadvertens se posse percipere fragmenta eorum praeteritorum et praesentium fatum, similiter ac cum Mercurium Cadentem ad aliorum fata discernenda utebatur.

source: The difference now was that he could see it directly, without extending his spirituality.
target: Differentia nunc erat quod id directe videre poterat, sine extensione spirituali.

source: With the right abilities, he could touch the ethereal river that shimmered with mercury-like ripples, woven from intricate symbols.
target: Cum rectis facultatibus, poterat tangere flumen aetherium, quod undis mercurii similes micare videbatur, ex subtilibus symbolis contextum.

source: Put another way, he could “see” part of a target’s fate without their awareness.
target: Alio modo, partem fatae obiecti videre poterat, sine eorum conscientia.

source: Naturally, compared to touching the corresponding fate river through abilities, there were clear limits to relying on eyesight.
target: Naturaliter, comparatus ad tactum fluminis fatum per facultates, limites erant, si solum visu innitor.

source: Most life scenes in the mercury river were quite hazy in such cases.
target: Plurimae scaenae vitae in flumine mercurii in his casibus satis nebulosae erant.

source: The nearer to the present, the sharper they became.
target: Quo propius ad praesentem accedebant, tanto acutius apparebant.

source: Likewise, the less they involved high-level matters, the clearer they appeared.
target: Similiter, quo minus res altioris momenti implicatae erant, tanto clarius apparuerunt.

source: Franca and Hela’s life scenes presented a vivid, striking contrast in this regard.
target: Scaenae vitae Francae et Helae in hoc sensu contrarium vividum atque mirabile ostenderunt.

source: Past and present fragments manifesting in Hela’s fate river’s mercury ripples seemed veiled in fog, while others appeared cloaked in night, making them indiscernible.
target: Fragmenta praeterita et praesentia, quae in undis mercurii fluminis fatum Helae manifesta erant, quasi in nebula latent, videbantur, dum aliae in nocte opertae apparuerunt, unde discerpti esse non poterant.

source: Only a handful could be perceived.
target: Solum pauci percipi poterant.

source: Franca’s was far clearer.
target: Scaenae vitae Francae multo clarior apparuerunt.

source: Especially in the last week or two, Lumian could see everything except scenes with high-level entities like the Evernight Nation, Madam Judgment, and the Demoness of Black.
target: Praesertim in hebdomada vel duabus hebdomadibus ultimis, Lumian omnia videre poterat, exceptis scaenis cum entibus altiorum qualis Natione Perpetuae Noctis, Domina Iudicii, atque Daemone Nigrae.

source: During his exploratory observation, Lumian was abruptly startled.
target: Durante exploratione, Lumian subito perterritus est.

source: After a few seconds, he looked away, unsettled.
target: Post paucas secundas, se avertit, perturbatus.

source: “What’s the matter?” Franca inquired, curious and concerned.
target: “Quid accidit?” Franca inquisivit, curiosa et sollicita.

source: “If you prefer not to disclose your specific abilities, that’s fine.”
target: “Si mavis non divulgare facultates tuas singulares, nihil est.”

source: Only then did she realize she had been too eager to ask about the Fate Appropriator’s situation and potential abilities in front of Madame Hela.
target: Tum sola animadvertit se nimis festinasse quaerere de condicione et facultatibus Fati Appropriatoris coram Domina Hela.

source: Lumian couldn’t help swallowing hard.
target: Lumian non potuit non vehementer deglutire.

source: Composing himself, he met Hela’s gaze.
target: Se composuit et Helae oculos respexit.

source: “There’s nothing I can’t share.”
target: “Nihil est quod non possim communicare.”

source: “I can no longer just observe luck.”
target: “Nunc non possum solum fortunam observare.”

source: “I can directly perceive the fate river corresponding to each of you.”
target: “Possum directe percipere flumen fatum cuiusque vestri.”

source: “It ranges from the main course to the tributaries, but most is indistinct.”
target: “Ab principali usque ad tributaria se extendit, sed plerumque indistinctum est.”

source: “I can only clearly detect it when actively using my fate‐hunting ability, and there’s a time constraint.”
target: “Illud clare tantum detego, cum facultatem fatum venandi active utor, et tempus constrictum est.”

source: “Indeed, among the fate river tributaries I saw, one likely leads to death…”
target: “Revera, inter tributaria fluminis fatum quae vidi, unum verisimiliter ad mortem ducitur…”

source: Lumian succinctly recounted his initial theory, the hue of his eyes gradually normalizing.
target: Lumian succincte primam theoriam suam exposuit, dum color oculorum eius paulatim normalis fieri videbatur.

source: “If death isn’t inevitable, it should be termed a death calamity,” Franca remarked, focusing on the symbolic import of “black.”
target: “Si mors non inevitabilis est, calamitatem mortis esse debet,” Franca dixit, symbolica significatio vocabuli “niger” attendens.

source: Death calamity? Lumian and Hela turned to Franca, awaiting clarification.
target: Calamitas mortis? Lumian et Hela ad Francam converterunt, claritatem exspectantes.

source: Franca laughed self‐consciously.
target: Franca verecunde risit.

source: “Simply put, if you navigate a catastrophe, crisis, or incident that could cause death, you might emerge alive.”
target: “Simpliciter, si calamitatem, discrimen aut rem quae mortem inferre potest transeas, fortasse vivus evaderis.”

source: I see… Lumian considered briefly before saying, “Then I’ll dub this ability the Eye of Calamity—eyes that can perceive death calamities.”
target: “Intellego…” Lumian brevi temporis cogitavit, deinde dixit: “Ergo hanc facultatem Oculum Calamitatis nuncupabo—oculi qui calamitates mortis percipere possunt.”

source: The name mattered little to him. Its utility was paramount.
target: Nomen pauca ei cura fuit. Utilitas eius maxime praevalebat.

source: Lumian then absorbed the mystical knowledge that had entered his body along with a Fate Appropriator’s power.
target: Lumian deinde scientiam mysticam, quae cum potentia Fati Appropriatoris in corpus eius intraverat, absoruit.

source: A Fate Appropriator’s core actually lay in fate appropriation, split into three abilities.
target: Nucleus Fati Appropriatoris re vera in appropriatione fatum consistit, quae in tres facultates divisa est.

source: The first was Fate Appropriation. By touching the target’s fate river, he could appropriate and extract the desired fate.
target: Prima erat appropriatio fatum. Tacto flumine fatum obiecti, fatum desideratum sibi appropriari et extrahere poterat.

source: This differed somewhat from Fallen Mercury’s abilities.
target: Hoc aliquantum differebat a facultatibus Mercurii Cadentis.

source: One needn’t kill the target to appropriate their fate, but it required time.
target: Non necesse est obiectum occidere ad fatum eorum appropriandum, sed tempus requiritur.

source: The less weighty the corresponding fate, the quicker the process, and vice‑versa.
target: Quo minus grave fatum conveniens, eo celerius processus est; et vicissim.

source: A fate fragment’s weightiness denoted its significance to the target’s overall fate.
target: Gravitas fragmenti fatum significabat momentum eius in universo fatum obiecti.

source: Naturally, Lumian could also appropriate a fragment of the target’s fate by slaying them.
target: Naturaliter, Lumian etiam fragmentum fatum obiecti appropriari poterat, eum occidendo.

source: Moreover, the target’s overall fate would be locked without further changes.
target: Praeterea, fatum universum obiecti sine ulterioribus mutationibus claudetur.

source: The time to complete the Appropriation was very brief.
target: Tempus ad appropriationem perficiendam valde breve erat.

source: As a Fate Appropriator, Lumian could compress two fate fragments within himself, surpassing Fallen Mercury’s single one.
target: Ut Fatum Appropriator, Lumian intra se duo fragmenta fatum comprimere poterat, unam Mercurii Cadentis solitariam superans.

source: Usually, there could be three, but Lumian hadn’t been a Dancer or acted as an Alms Monk.
target: Fere tres esse poterant, sed Lumian nec saltator nec monachus eleemosynarius fuit.

source: He hadn’t even signed a full set of special contracts.
target: Ne etiam plenum corpus contractuum specialium subscripserat.

source: Meaning, during the Inevitability domain’s initial trio of stages, he had seldom neared the power bestower in daily life.
target: Id significat, in primis tribus gradibus dominii Inevitabilitatis, vix cotidie ad dator potentiae accesserat.

source: The fusion with the powers was comparatively weak.
target: Hac de re, ei commoditas et flexibilitas Mercurii Cadentis defuerunt.

source: Had he not cultivated an Ascetic’s core spirit, perhaps he could have stored merely one fate fragment.
target: Si non nucleum spiritus ascetici coluisset, forsitan solum unum fragmentum fatum reservare potuisset.

source: The second ability was Fate Exchange, where one’s accrued fate was traded for a specific fate of the target.
target: Secunda facultas erat Fatum Commutatio, ubi fatum concessum pro certo objeto fatum commutabatur.

source: Ideally, the fate fragments’ weightiness should match. Light for light, heavy for heavy.
target: Optime, gravitas fragmentorum fatum congruere debet: leve pro levi, grave pro gravi.

source: If not, the exchange would be quite slow, maybe taking five to six minutes.
target: Aliter, commutatio lente esset, fortasse quinque ad sex minuta occupans.

source: The fate fragment’s importance was one facet, while its importance to the individual was another.
target: Momentum fragmenti fatum unum facies erat, dum eius momentum ad individuum alterum.

source: Together, they would influence the exchange speed.
target: Simul, has res commutationis celeritatem afficere possunt.

source: Still, generally, it was swifter than directly appropriating the corresponding fate—barring appropriating from a slain target.
target: Tamen, in genere, celerius erat quam fatum conveniens directe appropriandum, excepto quod ex caeso obiecto fatum accipiendum esset.

source: Be it Fate Appropriation or Fate Exchange, there were limits barring him from attacking targets until he finished them.
target: Sive Fatum Appropriatio sive Fatum Commutatio, limites erant, quae eum ab aggressu obiectis retinebant, donec eos absolueret.

source: In this respect, it lacked Fallen Mercury’s convenience and flexibility.
target: Hac de re, ei commoditas et flexibilitas Mercurii Cadentis defuerunt.

source: The third ability was Compelling Fate. It entailed expending an enormous amount of spirituality to directly compel the target’s future toward a tributary.
target: Tertia facultas erat Fatum Coercitio. Ea requirebat ingentem quantitatem spiritualitatis, ut fatum futura obiecti directe in tributariam partem coegeretur.

source: Originally, this ability didn’t function this way.
target: Prorsus, haec facultas non ita functa erat.

source: It primarily swayed the target’s future fate via rituals, curses, and other means.
target: Primum, per ritus, maledicta, aliisque modis, fatum futurum obiecti ferebatur.

source: Yet, after fusing with the Reaper trait, it could directly compel fates.
target: Attamen, postquam cum indole Messoris fusum est, fata directe compellere poterat.

source: This combination with the Eye of Calamity allowed Lumian to discern certain possibilities.
target: Haec coniunctio cum Oculo Calamitatis Lumiano permisit ut quasdam possibilitates discerneret.

source: Naturally, after careful assessment, he deduced his dual spirituality as a Reaper and Fate Appropriator could only permit two compulsions.
target: Naturaliter, post diligentem aestimationem, deduxit dualem spiritualitatem suam, in qualitate Messoris atque Fati Appropriatoris, solum duos compulsionis modos concedere posse.

source: A Fate Appropriator’s core abilities are the deepening and streamlining of the Luck Transference Spell… Lumian gave an overall appraisal.
target: Capacitates nucleares Fati Appropriatoris sunt profunditas atque efficacitas Incantationis Fortunae Translativae… Lumian universam aestimationem proposuit.

source: Upon becoming a Fate Appropriator, the ceiling of contracts he could withstand as a Contractee had hit twelve.
target: Cum Fatum Appropriator factus est, numerus contractuum, quibus ut contractus subiectus resistens praevalere poterat, duodecim attingebat.

source: The endurance stemming from being an Ascetic had also risen markedly.
target: Patientia ex hoc quod Asceticus erat, signanter augebatur.

source: This spurred Lumian to mull signing two to three more contractual abilities down the line to diversify his combat style and bolster his related trump cards.
target: Hoc impulit Lumian cogitare de subscriptione duorum ad trium ulterius facultatum contractualium, ad stilum pugnandi diversificandum et chordas auxiliares confirmandos.

source: However, he wouldn’t truly sign all twelve, not even ten.
target: Attamen, revera non omnes duodecim, ne decem quidem, subscriperet.

source: That would surpass an Ascetic’s endurance.
target: Id asceticorum patientiam superaret.

source: Lumian had no wish to become a pseudo‑inferior Beyonder like Padre Guillaume Benet, whose weaknesses could be readily grasped and actions predicted.
target: Lumian nollebat fieri pseudo‑inferiore Beyonder, ut Padre Guillelmo Benet, cuius infirmitates facile agnoscantur atque acta praevidere valeant.

source: Another notable shift in an Ascetic was the accumulation of external fate fragments.
target: Alterum notabile in ascetico fuit fragmentorum fatum externorum congeries.

source: It had genuinely become a vital component of a Fate Appropriator.
target: Re vera, factum erat pars essentialis Fati Appropriatoris.

source: As for rituals such as the Animal Creation Spell, they could be streamlined.
target: Quod ad ritus, ut Incantatio de Animalium Creatione, attinet, facilius fieri poterat.

source: For instance, Lumian previously had to drape the target with a ritual sheepskin to transform them into sheep by chanting the incantation.
target: Exempli gratia, Lumian olim oportuit obiectum induere in pelle ovina rituali, ut in oves transformaretur incantationem recitans.

source: Now, he could use a more symbolic sheepskin to cover the other party to meet the prerequisite.
target: Nunc, poterat uti pelle ovina magis symbolica ad tegendum alteram partem, ita ut praerequisitum expleatur.

source: His flexibility as a Dancer had also grown.
target: Eius flexibilitas ut saltator etiam aucta est.

source: Lumian could now perform horrific and incredible actions.
target: Lumian nunc poterat gesta horrenda et incredibilia perficere.

source: If ordinary folk merely glimpsed the corresponding shadows he cast, they would deem him a monster.
target: Si plebe ordinaria tantum umbras correspondentes quas iaciebat intuebatur, eum monstrum existimabant.

source: Furthermore, Lumian’s spirituality had climbed substantially.
target: Praeterea, spiritualitas Luminum admodum surrexerat.

source: The most basic yardstick was that he could employ up to 17 Spirit World Traversals.
target: Fundamentum maximi momenti erat quod usque ad decem et septem Transitus Mundi Spirituum exercere poterat.

source: Nonetheless, both a Fate Appropriator and a Reaper had scant impact on his physical prowess.
target: Tamen, nec Fatum Appropriator nec Messor in virtute corporali eius validiter contingebant.

source: After verifying his transformation, Lumian thanked Madame Hela and asked when the next Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society meeting would be before returning to the real world with Franca.
target: Postquam transformationem suam verificavit, Lumian Dominae Helae gratias egit et rogavit quando venturus esset proximus conventus Societatis Investigationis Simiae Crispatae, antequam ad verum orbem cum Franca rediret.

source: Having returned The Fool’s gold coin to Jenna, Lumian briefly outlined a Fate Appropriator’s abilities and stated,
target: Postquam nummum aureum "Fool’s Gold Coin" ad Jennam reddidit, Lumian breviter facultates Fati Appropriatoris delineavit et dixit:

source: “Given my ability to directly perceive some fate fragments, I’ll settle on the concrete plan after observing Moran Avigny up close.”
target: “Cum mea facultas sit quaedam fragmenta fatum directe percipere, deinde consilium concretum statuam postquam Moran Avigny intime observaverim.”

source: “Okay.” Franca thoroughly endorsed any step that could lessen the risk.
target: “Bene.” Franca omnem actionem, quae periculum minueret, plenissime approbavit.

source: Lumian rose and said to Franca and Jenna,
target: Lumian surrexit et ad Francam et Jennam dixit:

source: “I’ll head out first then. Don’t forget to help me inquire at your mysticism gatherings if there’s the Harvest Priest potion formula and the matching Beyonder ingredients.”
target: “Ego igitur primus exibo. Nolite oblivisci mihi in vestris conventibus mysticis auxilium ferre, si formula poculi Sacerdotis Messis et congrua ingredientia Beyonder inveniuntur.”

source: “Got it.” Seeing Lumian off, Franca turned to Jenna, puzzled.
target: “Intellectum.” Videns Lumian discedere, Franca ad Jennam conversa, perplexa.

source: “Why is he acting a bit odd? Doesn’t he usually rile people up and quip before leaving?”
target: “Cur aliquantulum insolite se gerit? Nonne solet homines excitare et argutias facere antequam discedat?”

source: Jenna also found this atypical and sank into deep thought.
target: Jenna quoque hoc atipicum putavit et in profunda cogitatione se recepit.

source: Abruptly, her expression changed.
target: Subito, vultus eius mutatus est.

source: Jenna glanced down at the book in her hand, saying pensively, “Perhaps he just received the boon’s power and isn’t in a stable state. He needs to hurry back and rest.”
target: Jenna librum in manu sua intuebatur, cogitans, “Forsitan modo vim beneficii accepit et non in statu stabilito est. Festinanter redeundum et quiescendum est.”

source: Franca nodded, understanding. “Fair point.”
target: Franca annuit, intellegens. “Recte dicis.”

source: She didn’t linger on it or bother to. The night was lovely, and she couldn’t squander it on such trivial matters.
target: Non diutius de ea versata est neque curavit. Nox amoena erat, et eam in talibus res levibus perdere non poterat.

source: Avenue du Boulevard, outside the Champs‑Elysees’ Rose Conference Room.
target: Avenida du Boulevard, extra conclave Rosarum Champs‑Elysees.

source: Numerous reporters stood before the hotel’s signature indoor golden fountain, awaiting the arrival of Minister of Industry Moran Avigny, who had finished negotiations with the Loen Kingdom’s delegation.
target: Multi diurnarii ante fontem aureum interior deversorii signatum steterunt, adventum Ministri Industria Moran Avigny exspectantes, qui negotia cum legatione Regni Loen confecerat.

source: Lumian had switched into a pre‑prepared black tweed coat and half top hat.
target: Lumian in veste praeparata nigri tweedi et semi pileo transtulit.

source: He held a rented, new black‑and‑white camera without a tripod.
target: Tenebat cameram novam nigro et albo, conducatam, sine tripedio.

source: With his unremarkable, passerby‑like appearance, he mingled with these individuals as a fake reporter.
target: Cum aspectu suo mediocri, quasi viator, cum his hominibus miscuit se ut diurnarius mendax.
